The four blocker rows are source_row_id 1104600 ('Investments - non-controlled/non-affiliated Secured Debt Electronic Equipment, Instruments and Component'), source_row_id 1104569 ('Investments - non-controlled/non-affiliated Secured Debt IT Services'), source_row_id 1103523 ('Investments--non-controlled/non-affiliated Unfunded Commitments'), and source_row_id 1102785 ('Total Investments - non-controlled/non-affiliated'). The same accession contains named Antares rows such as Wildcat Topco and DT1 Midco with issuer and asset-type detail, confirming these blocker labels are not production position granularity.
